title: AI-Chain Events Alert — 2026-11-18
body:
**Today · FOMC October minutes, 14:00 ET / 20:00 Berlin.** The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on a 10–2 vote, both dissents favoring a hike. Watch how many participants leaned hawkish; ~75–85% odds of a December hike are priced. A hawkish read lifts the 10Y (5.10%) and hits long-duration AI first — semis and neoclouds — while power/utilities (DUK, SO, XEL) and the 15% cash sleeve are the intended ballast. Housing starts also due 08:30 ET / 14:30 Berlin.

**Just landed · Nvidia Q3 (Nov 17, post-close).** Revenue $115.8B (+103%), data center $107.6B, EPS $2.68 beat; Q4 guide ~$130B above consensus. First call without Jensen Huang. Stock +3–4% after hours — a relief bounce for semis and AI infrastructure, below the 5% alert bar; confirmation at today's open.

**Tomorrow ·** Claims + Philly Fed, 08:30 ET / 14:30 Berlin.

*Research note, not investment advice.*
